reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per product
  SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM products
)
SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
alternatives:
SELECT p.category_id, p.product_id, p.unit_cost_eur
FROM products p
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p2
       WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id
         AND (p2.unit_cost_eur > p.unit_cost_eur OR (p2.unit_cost_eur = p.unit_cost_eur AND p2.product_id < p.product_id))) < 3

SELECT t.category_id, t.product_id, t.unit_cost_eur
FROM (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM products
) AS t
WHERE t.rn <= 3

other_way.sql:
SELECT p.category_id, p.product_id, p.unit_cost_eur
FROM products p
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p2
       WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id
         AND (p2.unit_cost_eur > p.unit_cost_eur OR (p2.unit_cost_eur = p.unit_cost_eur AND p2.product_id < p.product_id))) < 3
other_way.tradeoff: Counting the products ranked above each one keeps the same 3 without a window, but it reads the table again for every product.
